pages.title: A pot over the fire
text: The Spirit Kettle is an iron pot hanging from a bone frame. It has to sit **over heat**: a lit campfire, fire, soul fire, magma, lava or an [Ember Bowl](pulse_lights) right underneath it.
It needs no totem to work, but it listens for one: the voice of the **nearest Resonance Totem** within 8 blocks is sung into every brew and shapes it.

pages.title: Brewing
text: Open it and fill the three seats on the left:
- **Reagent**: one raw [reagent](reagents), as the item (take it out of your pouch at the Song Bench). Its family decides the remedy.
- **Herb**: Spirit Reed, Ley Thistle, Echo Bloom, March Leaf, Moon Lily, Lantern Cap or Veil Lichen.
- **Base**: a **glass bottle** makes **2 tinctures**, **honeycomb** makes **2 salves**, **charcoal** makes **4 incense**.
A batch takes **10 seconds** and **24 Pulse**, drawn from the lattice when it finishes, and uses one of each input. The screen tells you if it is waiting on heat, Pulse or room in the output.

pages.title: Automation
text: Hoppers and pipes can feed it from the top and sides and take the brew out of the bottom, so a kettle can keep a camp stocked on its own.
Every number here is in the `healing` section of the common config.
